selection: Purposive, after source screening, to examine mechanisms and linked decisions. Not random, representative, preregistered, or held-out accuracy validation. Selection rationales frozen before coding.

cases.reason: Small merged technical contribution; discussion distinguishes manual testing from automatic tests and proposes clearer review guidance. Retain the later technical criticism as a distinct post-merge event.
Unmerged attempt to codify review abbreviations; directly references the earlier guidance revision in PR 16149.

Small merged technical change with a reported consequence of omitting a commit hash from an ACK and an attributable response.

Initial contribution-guidance document, with discussion of roles and contribution criteria. Codification need not establish new powers or verified rules in use.

research_question: Can IG 2.0 coding reconstruct how rules, norms, and technical constraints shape Bitcoin Core decisions, and how participants maintain or change those arrangements?
execution: Two batches of three, with source review and a feasibility decision after the first. One isolated primary coding per case; separate repeats for S01 and S03; separate source reviews of all cases. No external paid API calls.
batch_one_gate: Exact source traceability and mechanically valid coding.
At least bounded episode mechanisms with reasons, responses, outcomes, and alternatives.
At least one defensible procedure-setting or cross-level inference, or an explicit decision to narrow scope.
validation: Review all packet entries for omissions, every material institutional claim and event target, roles, governing activity, outcomes and mechanisms. Separate meaning errors, evidence-basis problems, convention differences, defensible alternatives and unresolved judgments. Raw outputs remain immutable after review; adjudicated analyses are separate.
interview_policy: Use summaries as discovery aids. Verify any claim used in analysis against available transcript/recording; retain date, speaker and timestamp where possible. Distinguish retrospective accounts, contemporaneous statements, and observed action. No automatic confirmation from agreement between summaries.
interpretation_limits: No frequency, causal-effect, model-versus-human or corpus accuracy estimates.
No automatic rule from a filename, norm from optional advice, recognition from assent, or enforcement from closure.
Constitutive grammar is not constitutional action. Technical knowledge assessment is not epistemic governance.
Repository integration is not Bitcoin network adoption.
